name: James
label: Roast
cta: Roast YOUR friend in a song
lyrics:
Intro:  
Hey James, you know we love ya,  
But it's time to lay it all out there!

Verse 1:  
Oh James, with your parking skills that make us weep,  
Every time you're near the curb, we just can't take a peek.  
You twist and turn, like a skater on a board,  
But when it comes to parallel, man, you can't afford.  
You’re the king of the three-point turn,  
And we all know your car’s got a permanent burn!  

Chorus:  
James, oh James, can't you see?  
You're taking up half the street, just let it be!  
With your parking woes, it's like a dance,  
We’re all just waiting for your second chance!  
James, oh James, face the shame!  
You're the parallel parking champ of this wild game!  

Verse 2:  
You claim you've got the skills, but we ain't falling for it,  
When you back it up, we all just sit and witness it!  
Neighbors gather round with popcorn in their hands,  
'Cause watching you struggle, it's a comedy that lands!  
Your car's got battle scars, it's like a game of dodge,  
You’d win big points if only you could just massage!  

Chorus:  
James, oh James, can't you see?  
You're taking up half the street, just let it be!  
With your parking woes, it's like a dance,  
We’re all just waiting for your second chance!  
James, oh James, face the shame!  
You're the parallel parking champ of this wild game!  

Bridge:  
So here's to you, our driving star,  
Just think of us, we’ll cheer from afar!  

Final Chorus:  
James, oh James, can't you see?  
You're taking up half the street, just let it be!  
With your parking woes, it's like a dance,  
We’re all just waiting for your second chance!  
James, oh James, face the shame!  
You're the parallel parking champ of this wild game!  

(Outro)  
So grab your keys, buddy, give it another try,  
'Cause we'll always roast you, but we’ll still love you by and by!
